panels.title: Query volume over time
panels.description: Count of queries per hour, from cpie.query_logs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, COUNT(*) AS queries FROM cpie.query_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Refusal rate over time (% of queries)
panels.description: Fraction of queries where the pipeline returned the canonical refusal (is_refusal=TRUE). Bucketed hourly.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_refusal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS refusal_pct FROM cpie.query_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latency percentiles (ms) — synthesis + retrieval
panels.description: p50 / p95 / p99 of synthesis and retrieval latency per hour. Watch p95 for regression signal.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, percentile_cont(0.5)  WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY synthesis_latency_ms) AS synth_p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY synthesis_latency_ms) AS synth_p95, percentile_cont(0.5)  WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY retrieval_latency_ms) AS retrieval_p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY retrieval_latency_ms) AS retrieval_p95 FROM cpie.query_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top-cited docs (last 24h)
panels.description: How often each doc_id appears in cited_doc_ids. Counts repeated citations (one query citing the same doc 3× counts 3).

targets.rawSql: SELECT doc, COUNT(*) AS citations FROM (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(cited_doc_ids) AS doc FROM cpie.query_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)) t GROUP BY doc ORDER BY citations DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Cumulative cost (last 24h)
panels.description: SUM(cost_usd) in the selected window. USD.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost FROM cpie.query_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Cost per day ($)
panels.description: Daily API spend from SUM(cost_usd) GROUP BY day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS time, SUM(cost_usd)::float AS cost FROM cpie.query_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: User feedback ratio (thumbs up / total votes)
panels.description: From cpie.user_feedback (Streamlit widget in Step 4d). Empty until humans start voting.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN feedback = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS thumbs_up_pct FROM cpie.user_feedback WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recent failures (last 24h)
panels.description: Every query with a non-null failure_reason. Empty on the happy path.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, failure_reason, LEFT(query, 80) AS query_snippet, model_used FROM cpie.query_logs WHERE failure_reason IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20
